# Copilot instructions

Commit messages and pull-request descriptions follow
[.github/instructions/commits-and-pull-requests.instructions.md](instructions/commits-and-pull-requests.instructions.md):
every commit subject starts with the Kaneo ticket (`JOR-55: adding a button`), the last paragraph carries a `Refs:` trailer,
and a pull request uses the headings of `.github/pull_request_template.md` and names the ticket (`JOR-<n>`, or
`Part of JOR-<n>` for partial work). A linked pull request moves the ticket to In Review; merging does not set Done — the
owner does. Project-wide rules are in `AGENTS.md`.
